summary: Iteration 3 tested: webhook format templates (slack/discord/json), per-server alert_overrides + alerts_muted, latency override triggers high_latency activity, mute suppression logged, incident comments CRUD (add/delete/422/404), public status page sanitizes comment fields. add_comment strips text but Pydantic min_length=1 runs before strip — a payload of only spaces would pass validation (assigns empty string in DB). Consider validator that strips first.
